subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Discriminatory Zone, hCG Doubling and Methotrexate Criteria

steps.tx: The hormone level above which a normal intrauterine sac should always be visible on transvaginal scan is the **discriminatory zone**. Around fifteen hundred to two thousand units, absence of a sac strongly suggests ectopic or failing pregnancy. It must never be used as a single rigid cutoff.
steps.say: The discriminatory zone is the hCG level where an intrauterine sac should always be seen.

steps.tx: Healthy early pregnancies raise hormone levels by at least half in two days, termed **beta-hCG doubling** behaviour. Slower rise occurs in most ectopics and failing pregnancies. A single value, however high or low, locates nothing by itself. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Beta-hCG doubling by half in two days marks healthy early pregnancy.

steps.tx: A fluid collection in the uterus mimicking a sac in ectopic pregnancy is a **pseudogestational sac**. It lacks the yolk sac and double decidual ring of a true sac. Mistaking it delays ectopic diagnosis dangerously. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: A pseudogestational sac mimics a true sac but lacks yolk sac and double ring.

steps.tx: Strict size, hormone and clinical limits for drug treatment form **methotrexate criteria**. Typically an unruptured mass under three and a half centimetres, hormone below fifteen hundred to five thousand by protocol, and no fetal cardiac activity qualify. Haemodynamic stability and reliable follow up are absolute requirements.
steps.say: Methotrexate criteria require small unruptured mass, limited hormone and reliable follow up.

steps.tx: Opening the tube and removing the pregnancy while preserving the tube is **salpingostomy**. It suits women whose other tube is absent or damaged. Persistent trophoblast in about one in ten needs hormone follow up afterwards. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Salpingostomy preserves the tube and needs hormone follow up for persistent trophoblast.

steps.tx: Day four to day seven hormone fall predicts methotrexate success, called the **day 4 to 7 rule**. A fall of fifteen percent or more between those days predicts resolution. Failure prompts a second dose or surgery. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: The day 4 to 7 rule predicts methotrexate success by a fifteen percent hormone fall.

steps.tx: Pregnancy of unknown location is the working label when scan shows nothing, termed **PUL**. Hormone trends plus repeat scanning sort most into intrauterine, ectopic or failing categories. Safety netting for rupture symptoms accompanies every PUL discharge. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Pregnancy of unknown location is sorted by hormone trends and repeat scanning.

steps.tx: Methotrexate is avoided with breastfeeding, liver or kidney disease, blood disorders and inability to follow up, listed as **contraindications**. A coexisting wanted intrauterine pregnancy also forbids it absolutely. Heterotopic risk after assisted conception needs special vigilance. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Methotrexate contraindications include liver disease and coexisting wanted intrauterine pregnancy.

steps.tx: Rupture can still occur during methotrexate treatment, so women receive strict **rupture precautions**. Severe pain, dizziness or shoulder pain means immediate attendance. Activity and intercourse restrictions apply until hormone resolution. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Rupture precautions warn methotrexate patients that severe pain means immediate attendance.
